commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' The referee gives a yellow card to Martin Satriano (Brest) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Lilian Brassier (Brest) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
87' Martin Satriano (Brest) sends an accurate short pass. Bilal Brahimi controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
84' Martin Satriano (Brest) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Brice Samba, who pulls off a stunning save!
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) replaces Nampalys Mendy.
82' Here is a change. David Pereira da Costa is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
81' Here comes a substitution. Romain Del Castillo is given a rest as he is replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
79' A cross from a corner kick by Brest is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
79' Martin Satriano (Brest) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
79' Martin Satriano (Brest) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
78' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

77' Wesley Said (Lens) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
77' Neat passing move from Brest in order to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
73' Lens have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
72' Here comes a substitution. Wesley Said (Lens) is brought on as a substitute for Elye Wahi.
71' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kamory Doumbia (Brest) replacing Mahdi Camara.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Jonas Martin (Brest) coming on for Hugo Magnetti.
69' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
67' 2:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
65' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Brice Samba.
59' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
58' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Jeremy Le Douaron is replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Martin Satriano (Brest) is replacing Steve Mounie.
56' Mahdi Camara (Brest) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
55' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sprays a pass out to Steve Mounie, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
51' Florian Sotoca (Lens) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
50' Marco Bizot (Brest) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

43' Bradley Locko (Brest) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
41' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) sends a long cross over to Elye Wahi, but Marco Bizot comes forward to gather the ball.
39' Elye Wahi (Lens) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
36' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) jumps into a tackle and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
32' 1 - 0 Ruben Aguilar (Lens) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
31' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.

29' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Marco Bizot anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
27' Elye Wahi (Lens) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
24' Steve Mounie (Brest) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
22' Steve Mounie (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Good clearance! Elye Wahi (Lens) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
17' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Lens out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
16' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
15' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) and Steve Mounie matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
12' Elye Wahi (Lens) is caught offside!
11' Kenny Lala (Brest) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
7' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
7' It seemed like Kenny Lala (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
6' Kevin Danso (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
4' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Brest will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart was nominated as the referee for this game.
